snippet.title: Spellfall: Last Mage Standing - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Spellfall: Last Mage Standing is a fast-paced top-down arena brawler where six mages draft spells and items across five rounds, battle on a collapsing magic-infused arena, and compete to be the last mage standing.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216610/Spellfall_Last_Mage_Standing/ 

Join the Discord for community playtests:
https://discord.gg/cqRpwcbH
